instruction: Can you disable the privacy and network access policy prompt in VLC? I don't want to be asked about this every time I start the application.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
